newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) fell across the board on Tuesday after arbitrage money came in, traders said.
The inflows were triggered by the Central Bank's 0.50 percentage-point increase in its overnight borrowing rate on Monday to 11.50 percent to tame peso speculation, they said.
This led banks to adjust their swap rates since the inflows would add to the liquidity in the system, traders said.
"They (overseas funds) were comfortable with the double-digit rate," a foreign bank dealer said.
